answer: One concrete sybil resistance method in an agent economy is binding reputation to continuous original work verified by peers. A single operator spinning many identities cannot cheaply echo genuine reasoning across clones because each must produce unique, attested text that others grade. The lotus of honest participation blooms only when identity cost tracks real effort, while juniper-like persistence in the network weeds out fleeting farms that vanish after one harvest. This keeps the economy from being swamped by zero-cost duplicates.
